book.name: Maliki
book.title: N'halo ghwa maha handa paghutyekwite na MALIKI

content: Kuhyuka kwa Yesu
Paliyomokite Lisiku lya Kupughwa, Malia mundu ndala ghwa ku Magidala, Malia maghwake Yakobu na Salome bhakihemela hilibhi hya kunungilila ngati bhaghutyeke mmili ghwa Yesu.
Malabhila puti puti, lisiku lya ulongohi lya juma ndo Jumapili, kamu palubalikiti luchubha bhakighenda kulindogholo.
Munjila bhakikonyana, “Ghani ghwa kutubhilingihila lila liganga panlyango ghwa lindogholo?”
Peni paalolekihite, bhakilibhona lila liganga likulu munu, likibhilingihwa kala kuhuma panlyango ghwa lindogholo.
Paabheghite mukuyingila mula mulindogholo, Bhakimmona nhongolo yumo ywakahwalite lighwanda lihuhu na kakitama mu mbande ya nnilo, nabho bhakibhughanikwa muno.
Naywo kakiaghombela, “Nkoto kubhughanika. Mungunpalaha Yesu, ghwa Nasaleti ywakabhangalilitwe mulipingika. Kahyuka, Kabhegha ng'obhe apa, nnole apa paanng'onjihite.
Hino nng'ende mukabhaghombele ahundwa bhake papamu na Petili, kukita, ‘Kabhalongolela kughenda ku Galilaya, akwo ndi bhatammona handa pakabhaghombilite.’ ”
Ndo bhakibhuka na bhakitugha lubhilo kuhuma mula mulindogholo bhakibha na bhwaghalihi nkulu na nkangacho, nabho bhaking'ombela ng'obhe mundu ywohele lilagho lyoheli kiyaha bhakiyoghopa munu.
Yesu kangunbwitukila Malia mundu nndala ghwa Magidala
Yesu pakahyukiti ngeha puti puti lisiku lya ulongohi lya juma, kakimbwitukila huti Malia mundu nndala ghwa Magidala, ywakabhuhitwe mandilu nhano na abhili na Yesu.
Malia kakighenda kubhaghombela bhala bhaabhegite mu kulongohana na Yesu, abho akibha akali bhangukukulika na kulila;
peni paayihwite kukita Yesu kakali kangukeka na kukita Malia kakimmona, bhakinhyubhalila ng'obhe.
Yesu kanguabhwitukila ahundwa abhili
Mbole Yesu kakiabwitukila abhili muahundwa bhake paabheghite mukughenda panje ya kitami na kakibhegha mu kibhungi kingi.
Nabho bhakibhuya na kubhaghombela ayabhe. Peni nabho bhakihyubhalila ng'obhe.
Yesu kanguabwitukila ahundwa mbinda mabhoko yimo na yumo

Mbole Yesu kakiabwitukia bhala ahundwa bhake mbinda maboko yimo na yumo, paabheghite mukulyegha hilyo. Kakiandakila kwa ghwagahyubhalila ghwabhe na unonopo ghwa myoyo yabhe, Kiyaha bhakibhahyubhalila ng'obhe bhala bhammonite mbole ya kuhyuka.
Kakiaghombela, “Nng'ende kumilima hyoha, mukalandamihe Nhalo ghwa Maha kwa bhandu bhoha.
Ywohele ywakahyubhalila na kubatiswa katalopoka. Peni ywohele ywa nga kuhyubhalila katatoswa.
Nayo mihabho ayi yabhegha papamu na bhala bhanakuyubhalila. Kwa lihina lyangu bhabhuha mandilu, na bhayobhela kwa nongelo ya hyono,
handa paakamula mayoka, ebu paanywegha lusungu lwoheli, bhaatebhaha ng'obhe, bhatayabhika mabhoko ghabhe kwa atamwa nabho bhatalama.”
Yesu kangutolwa kuluhingu kwa Chapanga
Mbole ya kughomba agha Bambo Yesu, kakitolwa kunani kuluhingu na kakitama mumbande ya nnilo ghwa Chapanga.
Ndo ahundwa bhake bhakibhuka, bhakilandamiha kwoha, naywo Bambo kakitenda lihengo papamu nabho na kutengelekeha nhalo ghwake kwa mihabho yilongohanite nabho.
